# Onefifty

> Onefifty is a pop-rock band from Yogyakarta, Indonesia, formed in 2022 by lecturers and professionals at Universitas AMIKOM Yogyakarta, that makes live music shows for brands. Headline: "Brand punya cerita. Kami bikin show-nya." (Your brand has a story. We make the show.) A show can live on TikTok and Reels, or be taken to a stage. "KOL membuat konten tentang brand. Onefifty membuat show tentang brand." (KOLs make content about a brand; Onefifty makes a show about it.)

## One show, many lives

- Social Show (the starting point): a show made for one brand and filmed vertically for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Make, record, publish. No event, big venue or large crowd needed. Example outputs: hero video, Reels, TikTok, Shorts, behind the scenes, cutdowns. Content can be posted and boosted from the brand's own account.
- Live Show: the same concept taken to an event, campus, festival, launch or community gathering. Make, perform, interact. Outputs: performance, brand interaction, audience activation, documentation.
- Social to Live: brands do not have to choose upfront. Start with content; if it works, take the same show to a live audience. "Content becomes experience."
- Example idea (not a past client): for a coffee brand, instead of a "coffee review" video, a mini show where the band plays, the product is part of the scene, there is a gimmick and audience sing-along, filmed vertically and cut into Reels and TikToks.
- Inside a show: Play (music performance), Experience (the product enters the story), Interact (audience takes part: voting, challenges, sampling, vouchers, giveaways). Share is the distribution layer that turns moments into TikTok/Reels/Shorts content.
- Pricing: Stage Show from Rp3 million per event. Reels Show is priced by concept, production, number of videos and content usage rights.

## Live show and event hub

- For stage shows: (A) pick an upcoming Jogja event from the curated list; (B) "Saya sudah punya event": send a brief for your own event; (C) "Belum tahu event apa": choose target audience, goal and brand category, and the site shows the most relevant events by category and audience (not a promise of results).
- Events are curated from public sources and are not owned by Onefifty. Audience segments and brand fit are Onefifty's own assessment; unknown data (attendance, organizer) is shown as "Belum tersedia" rather than estimated. Presence at an event still requires the organizer's approval; Onefifty helps approach them.
- The activation builder sends a pre-filled WhatsApp brief: event, brand, goal, chosen activations and budget range.

## Track record and contact

- Audiences reached at past live shows: students, graduating young professionals, creative, technology and academic communities, entrepreneurs/UMKM. Largest recorded: 1,500 new students at Welcome Party 2026.
- Brand categories with a natural fit (opportunities, not past clients): coffee & F&B, bank/fintech/e-wallet, telco, gadgets & laptops, software/SaaS, gaming, education/edtech, fashion, marketplace, logistics, office/productivity, creative industry.
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 821-3612-3205 (https://wa.me/6282136123205) or Instagram @onefifty.band.

## The name
The name comes from "Asisten Ahli 150", the first academic rank (Jabatan Fungsional Akademik) of an Indonesian lecturer. First rank, first step: that is where the members started playing together.

## Members

- Arif Akbarul Huda: ML/AI Engineer; music producer
- Arifiyanto Hadinegoro: Soft Computing; guitar, bass, drums
- Agit Amrullah: Computer Vision; bass or guitar
- Muhammad Tofa Nurcholis: Game Development; vocals
- Anggit Ferdita Nugraha: Programmer; drums
- Rifda Faticha: UI/UX Researcher; vocals
- Fajar Sigit Purnomo: Computer Network Engineer; bass
- Nadea Cipta Laksmita: AI Music; keyboard, music producer
- Muhammad Najih Fasya: Urban & Regional Planning Researcher; vocals

The lineup is not always the same; it is adjusted to each event.

## Booking and collaboration

Use the event hub on the website, or share the date, venue and an overview of the event via WhatsApp (https://wa.me/6282136123205) or Instagram @onefifty.band (https://www.instagram.com/onefifty.band). Full band or acoustic, from 2 songs up to 3 sessions, with their own monitors.
